description: Prices the AI steps behind one request from current list prices (LLM tokens, images, video seconds or a fixed amount) and returns the cost per request, the real cost per result that worked first time (cost per request divided by the worked-first-time share), the monthly spend wasted on results that didn't work, and credit-pricing numbers: margin per result and the credits per request needed to break even or reach a target margin.

pricing.description: Credit pricing. Defaults: $10 for 1,000 credits, 1 credit per request, a 2.9% + $0.30 fee and a 70% target margin.

chargeOnlyWorked.description: True if users are charged only for results that worked

creditsPerRequest.description: Credits charged each time the AI runs

feeFixedUsd.description: Payment processor fixed fee per pack, USD

feePct.description: Payment processor fee, percent of the pack price

packPriceUsd.description: What a user pays for one credit pack, USD

targetMarginPct.description: Gross margin wanted on each result that worked, percent

steps.description: The AI steps behind one request, priced from /models.json. Their costs add up to the cost per request.

cachedInputPct.description: Share of input tokens billed at the provider's cached-input price, 0 to 100

model.description: LLM model id from /models.json, for example anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5

note.description: What the step does, for your own reference

model.description: Image model id from /models.json, for example google/nano-banana-2.1

note.description: What the step does, for your own reference

variant.description: Quality and size label exactly as listed for the model in /models.json

model.description: Video model id from /models.json, for example google/veo-3.1-fast

note.description: What the step does, for your own reference

variant.description: Resolution and audio label exactly as listed for the model in /models.json

label.description: What the step is, for example a speech-to-text API

usd.description: What this step costs per request, in USD

workedFirstTimePct.description: Share of results that worked first time: no try again, undo, fix, re-ask or overrule. 1 to 100.

name: real_cost_per_result

costPerRequestUsd.description: Sum of the steps' costs for one request

breakEvenCreditsPerRequest.description: Fewest whole credits per request that don't lose money

marginPct.description: Gross margin per result that worked; null when revenue is zero

netPerCreditUsd.description: What one credit brings in after payment fees

revenuePerResultUsd.description: Net revenue per result that worked

suggestedCreditsPerRequest.description: Fewest whole credits per request that reach the target margin

userPricePerResultUsd.description: What the user pays per result that worked, before fees

permalink.description: A page on this site that shows this result, for a person to open

pricesChecked.description: Date the model prices were last checked

realCostPerResultUsd.description: Cost per request divided by the worked-first-time share: what each result that worked costs, counting failed tries

requestsPerResult.description: Requests paid for per result that worked

detail.description: How the cost was worked out

shutdown.description: The model's announced API shutdown, if any

wastedSpendPerMonthUsd.description: Monthly spend on results that didn't work first time

title: Real cost per AI result
